reason: A DSH Web GUI news aggregator that collects public RSS or Atom feeds, provides categorized in-app article reading, supports bilingual translation, and allows custom sources.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中聚合 RSS/Atom 新闻源，支持分类浏览、站内阅读、中英翻译和自定义内容源。
summaries.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin for aggregating RSS and Atom news sources with categorized browsing, in-app reading, bilingual translation, and custom feeds.

capabilities: Fetches public RSS and Atom feeds
Fetches and extracts article content for in-app reading
Fetches article images through a proxy
Sends text to a translation service
